overview_description.description: Legit Security delivers an AI-native Application Security Posture Management (ASPM) platform that identifies, ranks, and remediates security issues across development workflows. The platform integrates with existing AppSec tools to provide unified vulnerability remediation, code scanning (SAST, SCA), secrets detection, supply chain oversight, and visibility into software changes from code to cloud. It includes recent features for detecting AI-generated code, constructing AI bills of materials, enforcement of OWASP AI Top 10 policies, and AI agents that assist with discovery, prioritization, and remediation through natural language prompts.
